edhrec_live_discovery.qualification: Discovery and current page metrics only; high lift and inclusion do NOT prove card superiority. Storm theme page still showed historical synergy rather than newer lift labels.

whole_99_comparison.baseline_roles: Stage4 whole-99 and Stage10–11 protected-line audits remain operative; this review specifically challenges 5 and 6 simultaneous cuts beyond earlier <5 variants.
guardrails_preserved_in_all_three: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
challenge_beyond_selected_slots: Nightscape Familiar (reject sacrifice: turns on cumulative +{C} per Ignus/Birgi cycle and discounted commander)
Pyroblast and Pact of Negation (retain: protect stack on critical cascade/loop turn)
Bloodletter and Solphim (retain: broad loss/damage scaling, while Ob/Ghyrson exact-one package suffers replacement conflicts)
Call Forth the Tempest (retain: independent printed double cascade and MV8 access)
Keeper of Secrets versus Nalfeshnee (separately challenged by five-card variants to avoid assuming both six-MV 40K payoffs expendable)
whole_99_comparison.mana_tradeoffs: Baseline 34 lands and 3 Mountain; each 5/6 package 34 lands and 2 Mountain + one untapped legendary Mount Doom. Doom adds B flexibility and {1}{B}{R},{T} damage-to-all-opponents threshold X3 at the cost of one basic fetch target and 1 life when tapping for B/R. Four of the compared adds are lower MV than replaced nonland incumbents; this alone is not win evidence.
whole_99_comparison.impact: Impact is a direct Birgi-front + Grinning Ignus Ignus-ETB all-opponent payoff; Nightscape adds +{C} each sorcery-speed loop, with enemy Rule of Law or removal interrupting. One card Ponder cantrip lost affects selection, Breach setup and cascade hit quality.
whole_99_comparison.sanctum: Sanctum is {1}{B} first-main X3 (3 opponents) only if previously on battlefield; guarantees pre-hand-MV3 threshold then, unlike Ruinous {2}{B}{R} random opponent card which may be land. Losing 40K opponent spell theft and owner-life-loss source is real; Ruinous triggers on upkeep but cast-from-exile may yield higher threshold and 40K synergy.
whole_99_comparison.exalted: Exalted {2}{U}{R} upkeep random instant/sorcery recursion to HAND creates fresh eligible hand spell for Abaddon; inst/sorc cast ping only raises threshold for LATER hand spells, not the original. Noise Marine printed cascade and Sonic Blaster upon ETB cannot be ignored, especially after Call Forth chaining; Exalted is a returning previously cut 40K contender, not a never-before-seen card.
whole_99_comparison.sheoldred: Sheoldred {2}{B}{B} each opponent draw -> lose 2 life. Resolved Wheel of Fortune makes exactly seven draw events per opponent; for three opponents X grows by 3*7*2=42 on that own turn, or 84 under Bloodletter. Cascade granted to that Wheel on casting was locked BEFORE the draw/loss; no retroactive granting. Windfall draw count is variable, not always seven; unassisted opponent draw steps happen off-turn and do NOT raise own-turn X.
whole_99_comparison.sak: Sakashima copying controlled Abaddon (if available on entry) supplies a second independent static cascade grant to same eligible hand spell, stacking separately with Spark Double's clone possibility; copying costs {3}{U}, adds commander dependency, and replacing Nalfeshnee gives up copying cast-from-exile spells including permanents. If Abaddon is removed before copy enters, desired target may disappear.
whole_99_comparison.protected_adversarial: Rule of Law disallows cascade-hit cast and repeated Ignus creature spells; retained Neheb/Loyal/Assault avoids needing additional spells once assembled. Opposing board wipes take out Sheoldred/Exalted/Sakashima simultaneously; Sanctum/Impact enchantments persist only absent enchantment removal.

fully_specified_research_alternatives.name: WARHAMMER_RECURSION_DOUBLE_CASCADE_FIVE
fully_specified_research_alternatives.reason: Lower curve, all-opponent pre-main threshold, payable Ignus direct win, recursive 40K spell pinger, second Abaddon cascade source, land-based threshold. But Nalfeshnee copied exile spells/permanents and Noise Marine printed cascade are both substantial protected identity losses.

fully_specified_research_alternatives.name: WHEEL_MULTIPLIER_KEEP_EXILE_COPY_FIVE
fully_specified_research_alternatives.reason: At 3 opponents Sheoldred + a fully resolving Wheel makes 21 draw triggers worth 42 opponent life loss (84 with Bloodletter), adding large NEXT-hand-spell Abaddon threshold; preserves Nalfeshnee copied-exile engine. But Sheoldred {2}{B}{B} and Wheel require two specific cards, removes Keeper's Warhammer nonhand MV burn, Noise printed cascade, and Ruinous opponent exiling.

fully_specified_research_alternatives.name: RECURSION_WHEEL_SIX_BEYOND_FLOOR_CHALLENGE
fully_specified_research_alternatives.reason: Best distinct six-change synthesis on paper: early Shrine threshold, Ignus outlet, two different 4-MV engines for spell recursion and wheel multiplier, extra Abaddon cascade, land utility. But removing BOTH Keeper and Nalfeshnee together severely thins nonhand spell damage/copy engines; existing 40K Lost/Passionate/Prosper/Wild-Magic still remain, but this cannot yet be declared globally stronger.

comparative_judgments.reason: Higher early first-main consistency with one Shrine but loses high-ceiling 40K theft; provisional positive floor, not yet final whole-deck proof.
Strongest directly payable Ignus all-opponent win conversion, but loses low-cost selection and reduces proactive turn1 setup.
Warhammer 40K recursion and pings into subsequent hand cascade, but Noise's unconditional printed cascade on MV5 and Sonic Blaster are substantive.
Wheel/Windfall follow-up cascade X ceiling and life buffer, but double black 4MV, conditional wheel access, loss of printed cascade and Warhammer identity.
Additional Abaddon-specific hand cascade source. Nalfeshnee cut loses exile-spell copies and token copy; Keeper cut loses 40K nonhand printed-MV damage.
Adds black access and paid X3 activation in a land, but costs life on mana tapping and removes one basic fetch/field protection source; not a free cosmetic upgrade.
Upkeep X3 and personal draw at two mana, but opponents each draw too; gives them fresh interaction in response to Abaddon, and two-colored BR is harder than Sanctum 1B.
One-B cheaper red-permanent conditioned own Wheel pings, potentially doubled by Solphim, but dies readily and damage one is neither same as Sheoldred lose2 nor always enabled.

stop_rule: These three whole-100 packages are honestly researched, not treated as selected just because they hit five or six. High-cost new simulations are not justified while cut-loss oracle and role analysis remain decisive. No declaration of M7 global optimality, missing changed-candidate M6 I/J is an explicit hard blocker.
decisive_status: No five-or-six portfolio yet demonstrated strong enough after Noise+Ruinous+Keeper/Nalfeshnee 40K identity losses to claim genuine net superiority over the currently approved baseline. Sanctum+Impact promising core; Sheoldred-versus-Exalted and Keeper-versus-Nalfeshnee cuts require final qualitative adjudication. Do not submit these to owner.
next: Decide whether any of these broad 100 portfolios genuinely exceeds the baseline under realistic interaction and timing while preserving identity; consider alternatives retaining at least one major Warhammer value engine. If no honest 5+ is demonstrably better after bounded full audit, log an explicit owner-governance conflict rather than padding. Only once a defensible 5+ exact 100 wins: rebind fresh Oracle/legality and M6 changed-candidate P0/P1 I/J, reproducibility SHA and exact-head CI before owner presentation.
